# Reverse parser admission: known legacy syntax and diagnostic recovery.
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:service-shape compiler VIP-9: service declarations require the member body, not a colon shape; lane impl-hunt-admission

FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:fork-block compiler VIP-17: a bare fork brace-body containing statements is not a UnaryExpression operand; the compiler wraps it in a program and accepts it; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:fork-block compiler VIP-17: bare fork block statements have no Appendix A derivation; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:for-concurrent-line-break compiler Appendix A: `concurrent` is a keyword only before `(` on the same line; a line break after `concurrent` still compiles as the loop; lane impl-hunt-admission

FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:join-for-head compiler VIP-17: join is exactly as await, and TypeScript rejects `for (await x of xs)` with TS2487; `for (join x of xs)` reports only the operand error EK1704; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:join-for-head compiler VIP-17: join is exactly as await, and TypeScript rejects `for (await x of xs)` with TS2487; `for (join x of xs)` reports only the operand error EK1704; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:join-for-head-line-break compiler VIP-17: join's operand may follow a line break, as after await; `for (join\nx of xs)` reports only EK1704 where the await twin is TS2487; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:is-operand-precedence compiler VIP-7 and the pinned TC39 grammar: RelationalExpression [no LineTerminator here] `is` MatchPattern makes an is expression a RelationalExpression, which can't be the left operand of +, * or <<; the compiler reads `x is 1 + 1` as `(x is 1) + 1` and reports only TS2365; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:is-operand-precedence compiler VIP-7 and the pinned TC39 grammar: RelationalExpression [no LineTerminator here] `is` MatchPattern makes an is expression a RelationalExpression, which can't be the left operand of +, * or <<; the compiler reads `x is 1 + 1` as `(x is 1) + 1` and reports only TS2365; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:service-separators compiler Appendix A: ServiceDeclaration separates members as interface members, one Separator after each; `service S { n: number; ; m: string }` compiles; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:service-separators compiler Appendix A: ServiceDeclaration separates members as interface members, one Separator after each; `service S { n: number; ; m: string }` compiles; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:effect-type-slot-line-break compiler Appendix A: EffectType has [no LineTerminator here] before each slot; `number ! string !` then `boolean` on the next line compiles as one A!E!R; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:throw-comma-warning compiler VIP-41: the punctuator-only comma after a throw expression's operand is the warning EK1010 until the parenthesizing vibelang --fix ships (migration policy, effectscript-11), while Appendix A's ThrowExpressionInvalidPunctuator still excludes it; remove when the comma is an error again; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:throw-comma-warning compiler VIP-41: the punctuator-only comma after a throw expression's operand is the warning EK1010 until the parenthesizing vibelang --fix ships (migration policy, effectscript-11), while Appendix A's ThrowExpressionInvalidPunctuator still excludes it; remove when the comma is an error again; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:schema-effect-field compiler VIP-1: a schema field written with the effect modifier (schema S { effect id: string }) compiles with no diagnostic; SchemaDeclaration's Field has no modifier, and EK0108 rejects the same member in a type literal or interface; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:schema-effect-field compiler VIP-1: a schema field written with the effect modifier (schema S { effect id: string }) compiles with no diagnostic; SchemaDeclaration's Field has no modifier, and EK0108 rejects the same member in a type literal or interface; lane impl-hunt-admission

FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:module-require-identifier compiler VIP-40 and Appendix A: identifier ModuleSpecifier extends static imports; TypeScript ExternalModuleReference still requires a StringLiteral, but require(identifier) reports only EK4006 for an undeclared module
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:module-require-identifier compiler VIP-40 and Appendix A: require(identifier) has no native ExternalModuleReference derivation; EK4006 names a missing module, not syntax rejection
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:schema-jsdoc-field-type compiler VIP-15/29 and Appendix A: Field requires a source Type; JSDoc type prefixes ?, ??, ! and * are not source Type syntax, but schema mapping replaces the type and reports only EK2109
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:schema-jsdoc-field-type compiler VIP-15 and Appendix A: a schema field starting its type with ?? has no derivation; EK2109 is a type/value error rather than syntax rejection
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:schema-error-jsdoc-field-type compiler VIP-15/29 and Appendix A: schema-error fields share schema mapping; a JSDoc type prefix loses native syntax rejection and leaves only EK2109
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:dynamic-import-arity compiler Appendix A: inherited ImportCall requires one or two arguments; native TS1450 is CategoryMessage and the VibeLang build-exit filter ignores it
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:native-dynamic-import-arity compiler Appendix A: an empty native ImportCall has no derivation but reports only message TS1450, which does not affect the VibeLang build
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:import-meta-property compiler Appendix A and VIP-33: a bad import meta-property name or an incomplete phase import is not native syntax; platform EK4402 covers the node before native grammar rejection
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:import-meta-property compiler Appendix A and VIP-33: import.x has no MetaProperty derivation but reports only platform EK4402
